name: kiterp
description: Run frontend apps from the repo root (each app lives in its own folder). Use npm run dev to start admin (:3000), vendor (:3001), and business front (:3002) together.

scripts.dev:backend: docker compose up -d postgres redis backend
scripts.dev:
node scripts/ensure-backend.mjs && node -e "console.log('
  Local Vite apps (not Docker). Wait for Local: lines for ports 3000, 3001, and 3002.
  For Docker frontends instead, run: npm run dev:docker
')" && concurrently -n admin,vendor,business front -c blue,green,magenta "npm run dev:vite --prefix frontend" "npm run dev:vite --prefix vendor-web" "npm run dev:vite --prefix storefront-web"
scripts.dev:vendor: node scripts/ensure-backend.mjs && npm run dev:vite --prefix vendor-web
scripts.dev:business front: node scripts/ensure-backend.mjs && npm run dev:vite --prefix storefront-web
scripts.dev:admin: node scripts/ensure-backend.mjs && npm run dev:vite --prefix frontend
scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix vendor-web && npm install --prefix storefront-web && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.build:aws: npm run build:bundle --prefix vendor-web && npm run build --prefix storefront-web && npm run build:bundle --prefix frontend
